title: PSALM 46 POWERFUL MORNING PRAYER
text: And just say, "Jesus, I am available." Say it like you mean it. Jesus, I am available for whatever you want to do tonight. I am available for however you want to move. I am available. I hold nothing back. I surrender completely. Father, we thank you. We bless your name. We honor you in this place. Let your kingdom come. Let your will be done in the mighty name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth. Now, if you are connected to this broadcast, I need you to do something before we continue. Share this message. Send it to someone right now. Send it to three people. Send it to five people. [music] Send it to your family group. Send it to your church group. You do not know it, but someone out there is one message away from their breakthrough. Someone is one prayer away from their deliverance. And you could be the bridge. You could be the vessel God uses. Do not be stingy with the things of God. Share this word. Lives will change because of your obedience. Oh, let us worship. Let us create the atmosphere. The Holy Spirit is a person and he responds to atmosphere. He responds to hunger. He responds to desperation. Let us worship him now. You are here Lord. You are not far. You are not distant. You are not detached. You are here in my room. You are here in my car. You are here in my office. You are here in my hospital bed. You are here in my prison cell. You are here wherever I am. You are here. Oh, receive our worship, Lord. Receive our praise. Receive our adoration. You are worthy. You are worthy. You are worthy. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Now be seated. But keep your spirit engaged. Keep your heart open. What we are about to enter into is not ordinary. This is a prophetic encounter that will change the trajectory of your life. The title of this ministration is before 7 a.m. declaration that shuts every evil mouth. Today I want you to understand what we're dealing with tonight. This is not just a prayer session. This is a strategic spiritual operation. This is warfare with precision. This is combat with purpose. Open your Bible with me to the book of Isaiah 54:17. No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper, and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment, thou shalt condemn. This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord, and their righteousness is of me, said the Lord. Write this down, underline it, highlight it, memorize it. This is one of the most powerful verses in scripture concerning spiritual warfare. The Bible says no weapon formed against you shall prosper. Notice it does not say no weapon shall be formed. Weapons will be formed. People will plot against you. Enemies will scheme against you. Powers of darkness will strategize against you. Weapons will be manufactured, sharpened, and aimed at you, but they shall not prosper. The weapon may be formed, but it will not function. The plot may be conceived but it will not be executed. The scheme may be planned but it will fail. The arrow may be fired but it will miss. The bullet may be released but it will not reach you. This is your heritage. This is your inheritance. This is your birthright as a child of God. But there is a second part to this verse that many people miss. It says and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn. Here is the revelation. God is not only dealing with weapons, he's dealing with tongues. He's not only addressing physical attacks, he's addressing verbal attacks. He's not only concerned about what is done to you, he's concerned about what is said about you. Tongues will rise, mouths will speak, voices will be lifted, words will be released. And these words are not empty. They carry power. Proverbs 18:21 says, "Death and life are in the power of the tongue, and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof." The tongue has power, not influence. Power, the power to [singing and music] create or destroy, the power to build or demolish, the power to bless or curse, the power to release life or death. When someone speaks against you, they are not just expressing an opinion. They are releasing spiritual force. When someone curses you, they are not just venting frustration. They are deploying power. When someone pronounces failure over your life, they are not just making a prediction. They are attempting to shape your reality. This is why evil speaking is dangerous. This is why causes are not to be taken lightly. This is why we must respond to every tongue that rises against us. [music] But here is the key. The scripture says, "Thou shalt condemn you." [music] Not God, not angels, not pastors, you. God has given you the authority to condemn every tongue. He has delegated the power to you. He has transferred the responsibility to you. To condemn means to pass judgment against. It means to declare something null and void. It means to render it powerless. It means to cancel its effect. When you condemn a tongue, you are using your words against their words. You are deploying your power against their power. You are releasing your authority against their authority. And because you are a child of God, your authority is superior. Your power is greater. Your words carry more weight. This is what we are going to do tonight. We are going to condemn every tongue. We are going to shut every evil mouth. We are going to silence every wicked voice. And we're doing it before 700 a.m. Why? Because there is power in timing. Because the early morning hours are strategic. Because those who rise early gain spiritual advantage. Psalm 5:3 says, "My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, oh Lord, in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up." David understood the power of the morning. He positioned his voice to be heard early. He directed his prayer at dawn. He looked up with expectation before the day began. Psalm 57:8 says, "Awake up my glory. Awake sultry and hap. I myself will awake early." David made a deliberate decision to awake early. Not to check his phone, not to scroll social media, not to watch the news, but to awaken his glory, to stir up his praise, to engage in worship. When you rise early to pray, you are setting the tone for your day. You are establishing dominion before challenges arise. You are shutting evil mouths before they have a chance to speak. This is strategic. This is intentional. This is warfare. Now, let me give you more understanding. Who are these evil mouths? Where do these tongues come from? First, there are human mouths. These are the mouths of jealous people who cannot stand your progress. The mouths of envious colleagues who want your position. The mouths of bitter relatives who wish you failure. The mouths of false friends who smile to your face and stab your back. The mouths of rejected lovers who cannot handle that you moved on. The mouths of wicked neighbors who spy on your blessing to report to covens. Second, there are demonic mouths. Yes, demons speak. Satan is called the accuser of the brethren in Revelation 12:10. He stands before God day and night accusing believers. Demons also speak to your mind bringing thoughts of failure, worthlessness, and despair. They speak to your circumstances trying to manipulate outcomes. They speak through human agents using people as their mouthpieces. Third, there are altars that speak in the realm of the spirit. Altars have voices. When sacrifices are made, incantations are released, curses are pronounced, spells are cast, these altars do not fall silent after the ritual. They continue to speak. They continue to project. They continue to influence. Fourth, there are covenants that speak. When evil covenants are made, they establish legal frameworks in the spirit realm. They make demands. They claim rights. They enforce obligations. They speak against those bound by them. Fifth, there are curses that speak. When a cause is pronounced, it does not disappear. It travels. It attaches. It works. It speaks continuously until it is broken. All of these mouths have been speaking against some of you. All of these tongues have been rising against you. All of these voices have been releasing words of destruction, limitation, failure, and death. But tonight, we are shutting them down. All of them. Every single one. Let me give you another scripture. Go to Psalm 31:18. Let the lying lips be put to silence which speak grievious things proudly and contemptuously against the righteous. David prayed for lying lips to be silenced. He asked God to shut the mouths of those who spoke grievous things. He petitioned heaven against those who spoke proudly and contemptuously. This is a prayer you can pray. This is a request God honors. This is warfare that works. Go to Psalm 63:1. But the king shall rejoice in God. Everyone that swearth by him shall glory. But the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped. The mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped. This is a prophetic promise. This is a divine guarantee. God is committed to stopping lying mouths. He's dedicated to silencing false voices. He is determined to shut evil tongues and he does it through your prayers, through your declarations, through your exercise of authority. Now, let me show you the authority you have. Go to Luke 10 19. Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions and over all the power of the enemy, and nothing shall by any means hurt you. Jesus said, I give unto you power. This is delegated authority. This is official empowerment. This is legal endorsement. Power to tread on serpents and scorpions. This represent demonic forces. The powers that bite and sting. The agents of darkness that attack. Power over all the power of the enemy. Not some power, all power. Comprehensive authority. Complete dominion. Nothing shall by any means hurt you. Nothing by any means. Total immunity, absolute protection. If nothing can hurt you, then no evil mouth can harm you. If you have power over all the power of the enemy, then you have power over every tongue that rises against you. This is your authority. This is your inheritance. This is your weaponry. Do not just wish it. Do not just hope it. Say it. and believe that those things which he saith shall come to pass. Faith in your words, confidence in your declarations, trust in your decrees. If you declare that no weapon formed against you shall prosper, it will not prosper. This is the power of your tongue, this is the authority of your words, this is the might of your declarations.
